WP.name: Wettable Powder
WP.description: Dry powders that suspend in water. Must be pre-mixed into a smooth slurry before adding to tank.

WDG.name: Water Dispersible Granules
WDG.description: Dry granules that disperse into water. Mix with slurry first.

SC.name: Suspension Concentrate / Flowable
SC.description: Liquid suspension of finely ground active ingredient in water. Add after agitating powders.

SL.name: Soluble Liquid
SL.description: Clear liquid solution that dissolves completely in water.

EC.name: Emulsifiable Concentrate
EC.description: Oily liquid forming a milky emulsion in water. Always add LAST to prevent clumping.

COPPER.name: Copper-based (COC / Bordeaux)
COPPER.description: Alkaline copper compounds. Incompatible with acidic chemicals and organophosphates.

SULPHUR.name: Sulphur-based (Elemental / WP)
SULPHUR.description: Sulphur powder/granules. Never mix or follow with oil/EC sprays within 14 days.

FERTILIZER.name: Foliar Fertilizer / Micronutrient (NPK, Zinc)
FERTILIZER.description: Water soluble fertilizers like 19:19:19 or Urea. Dissolve completely.

reason.en: Copper compounds degrade oil emulsions, causing heavy leaf scorching (phytotoxicity) and nozzle curdling.
reason.te: రాగి (కాపర్) మందులను ఈసీ (నూనె రూప) మందులతో కలిపితే ఆకులు మాడిపోతాయి మరియు నాజిల్స్ మూసుకుపోతాయి.
reason.hi: कॉपर कवकनाशी को ईसी रसायनों के साथ मिलाने से पत्तियां झुलस जाती हैं और नोजल चोक हो जाते हैं।

reason.en: Mixing Sulphur with oil/EC formulations causes severe chemical burn on leaves, especially in hot sun (>30°C).
reason.te: గంధకం (సల్ఫర్) ను ఈసీ మందులతో కలిపితే ఎండ వేడిమికి ఆకులు తీవ్రంగా మాడిపోతాయి.
reason.hi: सल्फर को ईसी फॉर्मूलेशन के साथ मिलाने से धूप में फसलों पर गंभीर रासायनिक झुलसा होता है।

reason.en: Alkaline copper can precipitate micronutrients like Zinc or Phosphorus out of solution into useless sludge.
reason.te: కాపర్ మందులు జింక్ లేదా భాస్వరం వంటి సూక్ష్మపోషకాలతో కలిసి నిరుపయోగమైన అవక్షేపంగా (బురదగా) మారుతాయి.
reason.hi: कॉपर जिंक या फॉस्फोरस जैसे पोषक तत्वों के साथ मिलकर अनुपयोगी तलछट बना देता है।

reason.en: Compatible ONLY if mixed in proper W-A-L-E order: Pre-mix WP into a smooth paste first, add water, then add EC last.
reason.te: W-A-L-E పద్ధతిలోనే కలపాలి: ముందుగా WP పొడిని నీటిలో పేస్టులా కలిపి ట్యాంకులో పోయాలి, చివరగా EC మందు కలపాలి.
reason.hi: केवल W-A-L-E क्रम में ही मिलाएं: पहले WP पाउडर का पेस्ट बनाएं, फिर अंत में EC मिलाएं।

wale_rules.title: Wettable Powders & Dry Granules (WP, WDG)
wale_rules.desc: Make a thin slurry in a small bucket of water first, then pour into half-full spray tank.

wale_rules.title: Agitate & Add Water
wale_rules.desc: Stir the tank thoroughly to keep powders in suspension before adding liquids.

wale_rules.title: Liquid Concentrates & Suspension (SC, SL)
wale_rules.desc: Pour liquid flowables slowly into the running or agitated water.

wale_rules.title: Emulsifiable Concentrates (EC) & Oils
wale_rules.desc: Always add oil/EC products LAST, then top up the tank with clean water.

jar_test_guide.title: The 15-Minute Glass Jar Compatibility Test
steps: Take a clean 500 ml glass jar and fill half with the exact water you will use.
Add proportionate drops of chemical A (e.g. 1/4 teaspoon), shake well.
Add proportionate drops of chemical B, shake for 30 seconds.
Let it sit for 15 minutes in the shade.
bad_signs: Heavy sludge settling at bottom or oily scum on top
Jar gets hot or produces steam (dangerous chemical reaction)
Granules clump together and will not dissolve
jar_test_guide.conclusion: If any bad sign appears, DO NOT MIX in your 15L or 200L tank. Spray them separately.
